name: dovetail
title: Dovetail
description: Search, browse, and create content across your Dovetail workspace.
author: barlow

commands.name: search-workspace
commands.title: Search Workspace
commands.description: Search across all content in your workspace — docs, data, projects, highlights, tags and more.

commands.name: search-data
commands.title: Search Data
commands.description: Search for data across your workspace.

commands.name: search-docs
commands.title: Search Docs
commands.description: Search for docs across your workspace.

commands.name: search-projects
commands.title: Search Projects
commands.description: Search for projects in your workspace.

commands.name: browse-folders
commands.title: Browse Folders
commands.description: Browse your workspace's folders and drill into their contents.

commands.name: search-contacts
commands.title: Search Contacts
commands.description: Search for contacts in your workspace.

commands.name: create-data-entry
commands.title: Create Data Entry
commands.description: Add a new data entry to a project in your workspace.

tools.name: search-workspace
tools.title: Search Workspace
tools.description: Search across all content in the Dovetail workspace by full-text query.

tools.name: get-content
tools.title: Get Doc or Data Content
tools.description: Fetch the full markdown content of a Dovetail doc or data entry by id.

tools.name: summarize
tools.title: Summarize
tools.description: Generate an AI summary from a set of highlights, data, docs, or tags.

ai.instructions: When searching or referencing Dovetail content, prefer the search-workspace tool over guessing ids. Use get-content to read the full body of a specific doc or data entry before answering questions about its content. Always cite the Dovetail url of any item you reference.

preferences.name: dovetailApiToken
preferences.title: Dovetail API key
preferences.description: Create a personal API key in your Dovetail account settings
preferences.placeholder: Enter your personal Dovetail API key

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
